fusions.name: Through the Seam
fusions.desc: A thrust that deals 28 damage that ignores armour and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Spicule Spray
fusions.desc: Looses 3 spicules at once, spread apart, each dealing 5 damage with a 35% chance to leave the target [Exposed] for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Spined Palisade
fusions.desc: Raises a wall of spicules 5 tiles long that blocks enemies for 8 seconds. Enemies that touch it are [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Sealed Over
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a shield worth 20% of your maximum health closes over you for 6 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
